description: Sensitivity manifest for the generic harness scripts/sensitivity-run.mjs. The Python script scripts/sensitivity.py implements the actual computation per pre-registration.md section 6. The JSON below records the parameter inventory so the harness can re-invoke at +/-50 percent.
